subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core add an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` method that writes editable text under the resolved session workspace root?
rationale: The code is a new user-facing feature and host-file write surface; automation cannot decide whether that belongs in core as proposed, should be limited to touched files, or should be deferred.

options.title: Accept and port the admin writer
options.body: Accept the `operator.admin` session workspace writer, then require the branch to be rebased onto the current split UI before merge.

options.title: Narrow the writer
options.body: Require the save path to be limited to a maintainer-approved subset such as already previewed or transcript-touched text files.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Keep current main read-only and close or pause this PR if session workspace editing should not ship in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Accept and port the admin writer
recommendation.body: Accept the `operator.admin` session workspace writer, then require the branch to be rebased onto the current split UI before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the current read-only workspace file viewer and gateway file-reading boundary makes this the closest current-main ownership signal.
